title: Where does your UPI payment go?

scenes.say: You tap to pay. Ten rupees for chai. Done in one second.
scenes.caption: You tap to pay. ₹10 for chai. Done in one second.

scenes.say: But where did that payment actually go?
scenes.caption: But where did that payment actually go?

scenes.say: Not into the sky. Into a data centre.
scenes.caption: Not into the sky. Into a data centre.

scenes.say: A building full of servers, running twenty-four hours a day, storing and processing your digital life.
scenes.caption: A building full of servers, running 24×7, storing and processing your digital life.

scenes.say: Your reels. Your cricket streams. Even your A.I. chats.
scenes.caption: Your reels. Your cricket streams. Even your AI chats.

scenes.say: In September twenty twenty-six alone, India made over twenty-four billion U.P.I. payments.
scenes.caption: In September 2026 alone, India made over 24 billion UPI payments.

scenes.say: And data centres already use about one and a half percent of the world's electricity.
scenes.caption: Data centres already use about 1.5% of the world's electricity.

scenes.say: India is building more of them, fast. Mumbai, Chennai, Delhi, Bengaluru.
scenes.caption: India is building more of them, fast.

scenes.say: The good news? Over half of India's installed power capacity is now non-fossil.
scenes.caption: The good news? Over half of India's installed power capacity is now non-fossil.

scenes.say: Power the cloud with clean energy, and India's digital boom can be a green one.
scenes.caption: Power the cloud with clean energy, and India's digital boom can be a green one.

scenes.say: Follow The Green Solve for more.
scenes.caption: Follow The Green Solve

sources: NPCI: UPI monthly statistics, September 2026 (24.07 bn transactions)
IEA: Energy and AI (2025), data centres ≈1.5% of global electricity in 2024
MNRE: non-fossil installed capacity 300.5 GW (>54%) as of 31 July 2026
